NO ABNORMALITY DETECTED

ish 22q11.21(TUPLE1x2),22q13(ARSAx2)

In situ hybridization with probe TUPLE1 did not detect a deletion in the region q11.2 of chromosome 22.

(Deletions in this region are associated with the spectrum of disorders including DiGeorge and 

Velocardiofacial syndromes and conotruncal cardiac defects.)

This does not exclude the possibility of other mutations in this region.
